labels.name: Long thoracic nerve
labels.function: Hurt in axillary surgery; wall push shows a winged scapula

labels.name: Suprascapular nerve
labels.function: Notch entrapment: weak abduction start and lateral rotation, no numbness

labels.name: Axillary nerve
labels.function: Surgical neck/dislocation injury: weak abduction past 15°, badge numbness

labels.name: Musculocutaneous nerve
labels.function: Weak elbow flexion and supination; numb lateral forearm

labels.name: Radial nerve
labels.function: Midshaft fracture in its groove: wrist drop, numb dorsal 1st web space

labels.name: Posterior interosseous nerve
labels.function: Weak finger and thumb extension with no skin sensory loss

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Lost thumb opposition; numb palmar lateral 3½ digits

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Cubital tunnel behind medial epicondyle: weak finger spread/closure

labels.name: Brachial artery
labels.function: Torn by supracondylar fracture: cool, pale, pulseless hand

labels.name: Axillary artery
labels.function: Can be torn by anterior shoulder dislocation

labels.name: Clavicle
labels.function: Most commonly fractured bone, usually in its middle third

labels.name: Acromioclavicular ligament
labels.function: Torn alone by a direct blow to the lateral shoulder

labels.name: Coracoclavicular ligaments
labels.function: Also torn in severe separations, giving a visible step-off

labels.name: Glenohumeral joint
labels.function: Most dislocated major joint; over 90% go anterior (abduction + ER)

labels.name: Surgical neck of humerus
labels.function: Low-energy fracture in older adults that endangers the deltoid's nerve

labels.name: Midshaft of humerus
labels.function: Higher-energy fracture; ~10% injure the nerve causing wrist drop

labels.name: Long head of biceps tendon
labels.function: Most common tendon rupture of this muscle (Popeye bulge)

labels.name: Supracondylar humerus
labels.function: Pediatric FOOSH fracture; risks brachial artery and compartment syndrome

labels.name: Capitulum
labels.function: A line through the radial neck should always intersect it

labels.name: Annular ligament
labels.function: Ring a child's radial head slips under with arm traction (nursemaid's)

labels.name: Ulnar collateral ligament
accept: medial collateral ligament of the elbow
labels.function: Resists valgus stress; torn in throwing athletes

labels.name: Distal biceps tendon
labels.function: Rupture chiefly weakens supination; muscle bunches up

labels.name: Distal radius
labels.function: Most common FOOSH fracture; dorsal tilt gives a dinner-fork wrist

labels.name: Scaphoid
labels.function: Snuffbox-tender carpal; waist break risks proximal pole AVN

labels.name: Terminal extensor tendon
labels.function: Ball strikes the fingertip: DIP droops and can't straighten (mallet)

labels.name: Flexor digitorum profundus tendon
labels.function: Avulsed grabbing a jersey: DIP cannot actively bend
